tasks.verify: A FORK: the human answers `adopt` or `refuse` and /runhuman records it as `chose`. The measurement behind it (runs.jsonl `multiplier-does-not-explain-slot` at eae8d8d): a note reads `slot` rather than `fetch` in the hold census exactly when the derived CMD_SETTEMPO (calls per row) is NOT a multiple of the file's multiplier (Battle_of_Britain 4 % 2 == 0 -> fetch; Food_Feud 8/3 rounded -> slot), so the next note's arrival shifts by a whole frame. Rounding effective_frames to a whole frame before multiplying makes every CMD_SETTEMPO a multiple and removes the shift, at the cost of average-rate accuracy on multispeed files whose native row length is not a whole frame. The evidence to put in front of the human: --pace MEDIAN and drift on Food_Feud, Rasputin and Knucklebusters with a scratch prototype of the rounding, and a listen of one of them.

Done when each of the four files reads a non-(-1) pulse field from detect() under its own spelling -- Mega_Apocalypse the zero-page forms of PULSE_PROG_SHAPE (D6/B4/95 for DE/BC/9D), Mozart PULSE_TRI_SHAPE with the AND masks wildcarded ($0F delay, $F0 step), Commodore_64_Music_Examples PULSE_TRI_SHAPE tolerating the extra STA between AND #$1F and DEC, Chicken_Song PULSE_TRI_CMD_SHAPE with bounds chosen per voice instead of declining on non-uniform cells -- and fidelity pulse_span rises toward 1.0 on each (register-only, presets.json, -t 180, Commodore on its start subtune) with every other register column unchanged beyond the noise floor. A new spelling is a FALLBACK consulted only where the existing shapes matched nothing. The pulse_phase offsets (pulse_tri_offset / _TRI_* operands anchored on the literal shape bytes, goatwriter/pulse.py near 2179-2196) must move with the wildcarded shapes, or pulse_phase stays at .348 / .545 on Mozart / Commodore. Corpus byte-hash under fidelity._preset_opts over all 95 files: report converted/refused/compared/moved and name the files; the moved set is exactly these four (plus any file a census of the new shapes names, each listed) and Commando.sng still compares byte-equal. The held DIGI files are not touched. tests/test_output_sha.py will fail for the moved files until the orchestrator regenerates build/fidelity.json: report that failure, do NOT regenerate or edit SURVEY.md, presets.json, FIDELITY.md or QUEUE.md. OPTIMISTIC MERGE: python/h2g/detect.py is also edited by the uncommitted master_volume patch (find_master_volume, Detection.master_volume); keep the change additive and narrow. The new test goes in python/tests/test_pulse_spellings.py, which does not exist at this head. SABOTAGE-VERIFY: after the tests pass, mutate one wildcarded operand in one new shape (print the mutated line from disk) and show the new test fails, then restore by re-editing and show a clean diff of that line; do the same for the Chicken_Song per-voice bound choice.
